text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 detected - multiple websocket sessions dropping for customer `NovaHealth`. Path: /v1/chat/stream. Triggering oncall page.

diana: oncall here. Got the page and joining. What's the scope?

sam: I'm seeing spikes in 502/504 from our gateway logs and ALB logs show TargetResponseTimeouts. NovaHealth is on a dedicated pool in eu-west-1 with VPC peering.

priya: Support note: NovaHealth engineers started seeing streaming clients drop around 2026-03-15T09:14Z. They report reconnect storms and duplicate messages from aggressive retry logic. They also say they flipped a CDN rule yesterday.

lucas: Quick grep in gw-proxy logs shows repeated `write: broken pipe` and long queues on proxy workers. Example:

```
[2026-03-15T09:15:21Z] gw-proxy[proxy-3] WARN websocket: write error: write tcp 10.0.3.45:443->10.1.2.8:56789: write: broken pipe
[2026-03-15T09:15:22Z] gw-proxy[proxy-3] ERROR upstream: request timed out after 29s
```

eng-ops-bot: Ran `aws elb describe-instance-health --load-balancer-name novahealth-alb` - 2 targets marked Unhealthy temporarily.

diana: Immediate hypothesis: ALB idle timeout (default 60s) + gateway keepalives mismatched + a recent CDN rewrite leading to sticky long-lived connections. Also saw file descriptor usage hitting 85% on proxy nodes.

sam: For immediate mitigation we can: (A) increase ALB idle timeout to 180s for that target group (B) enable `proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Connection "keep-alive";` and bump `worker_rlimit_nofile` and `worker_connections` on gw-proxy config (C) scale gateway replicas.

priya: Customer willing to accept config changes; they prefer zero-downtime. They can also throttle client retries if we ask.

lucas: Preparing a non-disruptive change: patch ConfigMap `novahealth-gateway` with new keepalive and connection limits, then do a rolling restart of proxy daemonset one pod at a time. Also will update ALB idle timeout via infra-runbook.

(operators run commands)

eng-ops-bot: Command: `kubectl get cm novahealth-gateway -n novahealth-dedicated -o yaml` -> showing current keepalive: off, worker_connections: 1024.

eng-ops-bot: Applying patch:
```
kubectl patch configmap novahealth-gateway -n novahealth-dedicated --patch '{"data":{"keepalive":"on","upstream_idle_timeout":"180s","worker_connections":"8192","worker_rlimit_nofile":"65536"}}'
```

(rolling restart initiated)

eng-ops-bot: Rolling restart of daemonset/gw-proxy in namespace novahealth-dedicated started. Restarting pods one-by-one.

(6 minutes later)

eng-ops-bot: Canary pod stabilized. FD usage down to 42%. No 5xx observed on canary in last 3m.

priya: Informed NovaHealth: asked them to set websocket ping interval to 30s and reduce immediate retry attempts to max 2 with exponential backoff. They acknowledged and applying client-side change.

diana: Also opened temporary listener on backup gateway in another AZ and registered targets so traffic can drain if primary gets overloaded.

sam: I pushed an ALB change: increased IdleTimeout to 180. AWS change complete - took effect instantly.

(10 minutes)

support-bot: NovaHealth reports stable stream connections for 8 minutes, with the previous disconnect cohort reduced by 90%. Some long-lived connections still fail due to a CDN edge timeout of 60s - we're coordinating with CDN team.

lucas: Found a bug path in gw-proxy: when backlog of pending writes exceeds threshold we close websocket with non-recoverable code. I'll prepare a minimal hotfix to drop writes gracefully and throttle per-connection.

diana: Action items while we monitor:
- Hotfix gw-proxy to throttle writes and avoid abrupt close (sam)
- Add tenant-scoped connection limit alerts (diana)
- Document runbook for ALB + gateway streaming tuning (lucas)
- Customer-facing postmortem scheduling (priya)

sam: Creating PR for hotfix: https://git.redwood.ai/gw-proxy/pull/509 - backpressure + graceful close. Will try to get a canary out within 2 hours.

diana: Oncall handoff: I'll monitor for 20 more minutes then hand to Lucas overnight. Lucas, you okay taking this?
lucas: I can take overnight. Will keep eyes on metrics dashboard and the `novahealth-streaming` alert.

incident-bot: Incident severity changed -> SEV-2 -> MONITORING by diana.

priya: I'll coordinate the customer PM and include recommended SDK settings: ping <= 30s, max retry attempts 2, backoff base 1s.

sam: Before we close: add an alert for any dedicated pool where websocket 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m and fd usage > 70% across gateway pods.

diana: noted. I'll file the follow-ups in the incidents tracker and add owners.

support-bot: NovaHealth thanks the team and will review client SDK changes tomorrow.

diana: Logging incident summary and creating a new tenant-streaming runbook entry in Confluence.

(End of thread)
